facts.fact: Frasier录节目，Hottie of the Week直接低吼“我妻子”
facts.anchor: I hadn’t been at all surprised when he’d practically growled, “My wife.”

facts.fact: 炸弹：Cece与Gabe已在Vegas闪婚——她连恋爱都没听她说
facts.anchor: I wanted to know why one of my closest friends was suddenly married to a man I hadn’t even realized she was dating.

facts.fact: Cece承认已婚，回LA后补办庆祝
facts.anchor: “Yes, it’s true. And we’re going to have a huge celebration when we return.

facts.fact: Cece遗憾：若办真婚礼，伴娘必是Logan
facts.anchor: “If I’d had a real wedding,” Cece said, “you definitely would’ve been my maid of honor.”

facts.fact: 她自认：I’m in love with Carson
facts.anchor: Oh shit. My eyes widened at the realization. I’m in love with Carson.

facts.fact: 她把它类比成打冰球：有趣、兴奋、有挑战、值得
facts.anchor: Loving Carson felt as natural as playing hockey—fun, exhilarating, not without challenges, but ultimately rewarding.

facts.fact: 妈妈的忠告：不必一肩扛，小心burnout
facts.anchor: “It’s not all on you, Logan. You are a badass, and you are doing amazing things.

facts.fact: 妈妈：你和Lee是我做过最好的事，为你骄傲因为你本人
facts.anchor: You—and Lee—are the best things I’ve ever done.

facts.fact: 妈妈不后悔：和爸爸共享过梦想、建过美好的生活
facts.anchor: Even when it comes to Dad. We shared a dream and built a beautiful life together.

facts.fact: 她向妈妈承认在恋爱（没说对象是谁）
她要求妈妈保密——尤其别告诉Levi
facts.anchor: Only if you promise not to tell anyone. Not Dad, and definitely not Levi.

facts.fact: 采访里他罕见地卡壳——谈原生家庭之困
facts.anchor: He was usually very charming in interviews, fluid in his answers. But here he was, uncertain.

facts.fact: 他借采访暗告白：让谁都不因“爱谁”而被看轻
她确认：不必说出口，我们彼此相爱
facts.anchor: He didn’t have to say the words because I knew. I knew Carson loved me just as I knew I loved him.

facts.fact: 章末定调：我们是队友，一起追目标
facts.anchor: Because Carson and I were a team, pursuing our goals together.
